Figure 3: An overview of AutoSP. AutoSP enables an automated approach to scale input context lengths for long-context training through a targeted set of compiler optimization passes: an automated sequence-parallelism pass (Section 3.1), and a SP-aware long-context AC-pass: SAC (Section 3.2).
